definitions.name: BrowserProbe
definitions.doc: Typed browser smoke result replacing the former heterogeneous Map<Dynamic>.

definitions.name: DocumentHost
definitions.doc: External Document capability with typed state, title, and small selector/creation surface.

definitions.name: DocumentReadyState
definitions.doc: Typed document.readyState values with an unknown String variant for forward compatibility.

definitions.name: DomChildrenHost
definitions.doc: External DOM children collection with typed length and nullable indexed element lookup.

definitions.name: DomElementHost
definitions.doc: External DOM Element capability with stable fields, selector methods, attributes, and focus effects.

definitions.name: DomInputHost
definitions.doc: External HTML input capability. Mutable fields are declared in FFI metadata, not in the core trait type.

definitions.name: ElementSnapshot
definitions.doc: Calcit-owned subset of DOM element data suitable for business code without retaining host identity.

definitions.name: EventHost
definitions.doc: External Event capability. Targets stay nullable opaque objects unless a specific adapter narrows them.

definitions.name: KeyModifiers
definitions.doc: Normalized keyboard or pointer modifier state shared by event adapters.

definitions.name: KeyboardEventHost
definitions.doc: External KeyboardEvent capability without trait inheritance; adapters normalize keys and modifiers into Calcit data.

definitions.name: LocationHost
definitions.doc: External browser Location capability. Navigation methods are explicit effects; URL fields are readable.

definitions.name: MediaQueryListHost
definitions.doc: External matchMedia result with stable media and matches fields. Listener APIs remain adapter-specific.

definitions.name: MouseEventHost
definitions.doc: External MouseEvent capability exposing coordinates, button, and modifier fields used by adapters.

definitions.name: PointerPosition
definitions.doc: Normalized pointer coordinates and button index copied from a MouseEvent-like object.

definitions.name: StorageHost
definitions.doc: External Web Storage capability with nullish lookup and explicit String mutation methods.

definitions.name: Viewport
definitions.doc: Normalized viewport dimensions and device pixel ratio copied from Window.

definitions.name: VisibilityState
definitions.doc: Typed document.visibilityState values with an unknown String variant.

definitions.name: WindowHost
definitions.doc: |External browser Window capability restricted to stable viewport fields, matchMedia, and typed global event listeners.

definitions.name: add-event-listener!
definitions.doc: Register a typed browser window event listener. The callback receives an EventHost and the wrapper returns Unit.

definitions.name: append-child!
definitions.doc: Appends one typed DOM host element to another and returns the child. This keeps DOM insertion inside the browser FFI boundary.

definitions.name: cancel-animation-frame!
definitions.doc: Cancel a browser numeric handle; unknown handles are harmless.

definitions.name: child-element-at
definitions.doc: Return the indexed child element as Option, normalizing the host nullish result.

definitions.name: clear-interval!
definitions.doc: Cancel a browser numeric handle; unknown handles are harmless.

definitions.name: clear-timeout!
definitions.doc: Cancel a browser numeric handle; unknown handles are harmless.

definitions.name: console-error!
definitions.doc: Compatibility wrapper for shared/console-error!. It accepts one String and returns Unit.

definitions.name: console-log!
definitions.doc: Compatibility wrapper for shared/console-log!. It accepts one String and returns Unit instead of leaking host undefined.

definitions.name: create-element
definitions.doc: Create a DOM element through DocumentHost and return its typed host capability.

definitions.name: decode-document-ready-state
definitions.doc: Decode document.readyState String to DocumentReadyState while preserving unknown values.

definitions.name: decode-visibility-state
definitions.doc: Decode document.visibilityState String to VisibilityState while preserving unknown values.

definitions.name: document-available?
definitions.doc: Return whether document is present. Use this guard before touching DOM objects so shared code can be checked in both Node.js and browsers. Example: (document-available?) => true

definitions.name: document-ready-state
definitions.doc: Read and decode document.readyState through the typed DocumentHost contract.

definitions.name: document-title
definitions.doc: Read document.title through DocumentHost. Returns an empty String when document is unavailable.

definitions.name: element-blur!
definitions.doc: Blur an HTML element with blur capability.

definitions.name: element-dataset
definitions.doc: Returns the DOM element dataset object through the browser host contract. Use with js-set/js-delete for data-* attributes.

definitions.name: element-focus!
definitions.doc: Focus an HTML element with focus capability.

definitions.name: element-get-attribute
definitions.doc: Read a DOM attribute as Option<String>.

definitions.name: element-matches?
definitions.doc: Match a CSS selector; invalid selectors raise DOMException.

definitions.name: element-query-selector
definitions.doc: Find a descendant or return Option.none.

definitions.name: element-remove-attribute!
definitions.doc: Remove a DOM attribute.

definitions.name: element-set-attribute!
definitions.doc: Set a DOM attribute.

definitions.name: element-snapshot
definitions.doc: Copy a typed DOM element into ElementSnapshot, converting nullish textContent to Option<String>.

definitions.name: element-style
definitions.doc: Returns the DOM element style declaration through the browser host contract. Use with aset for normalized CSS property names.

definitions.name: local-storage-available?
definitions.doc: Return whether localStorage is available. Browsers may deny storage in privacy or sandboxed modes, so callers should branch on this Boolean. Example: (local-storage-available?) => true

definitions.name: location-href
definitions.doc: Read location.href through the typed LocationHost contract.

definitions.name: probe
definitions.doc: Run the browser capability smoke probe and return typed BrowserProbe data.

definitions.name: query-selector
definitions.doc: Query document for a selector and normalize a missing element into Option<DomElementHost>.

definitions.name: random
definitions.doc: Return a browser-compatible random number in the range 0 inclusive to 1 exclusive. The concrete return type is Number. Example: (random) => 0.42

definitions.name: remove-event-listener!
definitions.doc: Remove a previously registered typed browser window listener.

definitions.name: request-animation-frame!
definitions.doc: Schedule a frame callback receiving a timestamp; returns a cancellable numeric handle.

definitions.name: runtime
definitions.doc: Return the normalized Runtime browser enum variant.

definitions.name: runtime-name
definitions.doc: Return the literal runtime identifier |browser. This is useful for environment contracts and keeps callers independent from host-specific globals. Example: (runtime-name) => |browser

definitions.name: set-before-unload!
definitions.doc: Install a typed browser beforeunload callback.

definitions.name: set-interval!
definitions.doc: Schedule a repeated browser callback and return the numeric timer identifier. The callback receives no arguments and returns Unit.

definitions.name: set-timeout!
definitions.doc: Schedule a Unit callback and return the browser numeric timer id. Node timer handles intentionally use a separate contract.

definitions.name: storage-get
definitions.doc: Read one localStorage key as Option<String>; missing and JavaScript nullish values become none. Host exceptions remain an adapter concern.

definitions.name: storage-get-or
definitions.doc: Read localStorage as Option<String> internally and return the supplied fallback for a missing key.

definitions.name: storage-remove!
definitions.doc: Remove a localStorage key through StorageHost and return Unit.

definitions.name: storage-roundtrip!
definitions.doc: Exercise localStorage with a deterministic String result for smoke tests. It writes |ok, reads it back, and returns |unavailable when storage is missing. Example: (storage-roundtrip!) => |ok

definitions.name: storage-set!
definitions.doc: Write a String key/value pair through StorageHost and normalize the host return to Unit.

definitions.name: viewport
definitions.doc: Read Window viewport fields once and return normalized Viewport data.

definitions.name: viewport-height
definitions.doc: Return the height field from normalized Viewport data.

definitions.name: viewport-width
definitions.doc: Return the width field from normalized Viewport data.

definitions.name: visibility-state
definitions.doc: Read and decode document.visibilityState through the typed DocumentHost contract.

definitions.name: expect-bool
definitions.doc: Decode an opaque JavaScript value as Bool after a runtime kind check. Null and undefined are reported as nullish; other mismatches raise a stable JS FFI contract violation.

definitions.name: expect-function
definitions.doc: Validate that an opaque JavaScript value is a non-null JavaScript function and return its opaque host identity. Use a small typed adapter for its call schema and receiver contract.

definitions.name: expect-number
definitions.doc: Decode an opaque JavaScript value as Number after a runtime kind check. Null and undefined are reported as nullish; other mismatches raise a stable JS FFI contract violation.

definitions.name: expect-object
definitions.doc: Validate that an opaque JavaScript value is a non-null object and return it as JsObject. This proves only the shallow host kind; decode or check members before exposing concrete data.

definitions.name: expect-string
definitions.doc: Decode an opaque JavaScript value as String after a runtime kind check. Null and undefined are reported as nullish; other mismatches raise a stable JS FFI contract violation.

definitions.name: object-field
definitions.doc: Read one named field from an opaque JavaScript object after checking the receiver. The result remains JsNullish<JsObject>; pass it through an expect primitive guard or explicitly normalize absence before returning concrete data.

definitions.name: valid-runtime?
definitions.doc: Compare two normalized Runtime values without relying on open String identifiers.

definitions.name: NodeProbe
definitions.doc: Typed Node smoke result replacing the former heterogeneous Map<Dynamic>.

definitions.name: ProcessArgvHost
definitions.doc: External process.argv capability exposing only an opaque/nullish length that argv-count validates at runtime.

definitions.name: append-text!
definitions.doc: Synchronous node:fs.appendFileSync adapter. Text uses UTF-8; filesystem failures raise the original host exception. No recursive deletion.

definitions.name: argv-count
definitions.doc: Return process.argv.length as Number. This deliberately narrows the host array at the boundary. Example: (argv-count) => 3

definitions.name: copy-file!
definitions.doc: Synchronous node:fs.copyFileSync adapter. Text uses UTF-8; filesystem failures raise the original host exception. No recursive deletion.

definitions.name: cwd
definitions.doc: Return process.cwd() as String. This is a Node-only API and is emitted through the node entry. Example: (cwd) => |/workspace/project

definitions.name: env-or
definitions.doc: Read a process.env value with a typed String fallback. Example: (env-or |NODE_ENV |development) => |development

definitions.name: exit!
definitions.doc: Terminate the Node.js process with a numeric exit code. This effectful escape hatch has the Unit contract because it has no business result. Example: (exit! 1)

definitions.name: file-exists?
definitions.doc: Return whether a local filesystem path exists as Bool. The fs module is kept behind the Node namespace. Example: (file-exists? |package.json) => true

definitions.name: make-temp-dir!
definitions.doc: Synchronous node:fs.mkdtempSync adapter. Text uses UTF-8; filesystem failures raise the original host exception. No recursive deletion.

definitions.name: mkdir!
definitions.doc: Synchronous node:fs.mkdirSync adapter. Text uses UTF-8; filesystem failures raise the original host exception. No recursive deletion.

definitions.name: node-version
definitions.doc: Read and validate Node process metadata.

definitions.name: path-absolute?
definitions.doc: Call node:path.isAbsolute using native platform path rules and validate its result.

definitions.name: path-basename
definitions.doc: Call node:path.basename using native platform path rules and validate its result.

definitions.name: path-dirname
definitions.doc: Call node:path.dirname using native platform path rules and validate its result.

definitions.name: path-extname
definitions.doc: Call node:path.extname using native platform path rules and validate its result.

definitions.name: path-join
definitions.doc: Join two path segments using node:path and return String. Example: (path-join |src |index.js) => |src/index.js

definitions.name: path-normalize
definitions.doc: Call node:path.normalize using native platform path rules and validate its result.

definitions.name: path-relative
definitions.doc: Call node:path.relative using native platform path rules and validate its result.

definitions.name: path-resolve
definitions.doc: Call node:path.resolve using native platform path rules and validate its result.

definitions.name: pid
definitions.doc: Read and validate Node process metadata.

definitions.name: platform
definitions.doc: Read and validate Node process metadata.

definitions.name: probe
definitions.doc: Run the Node capability smoke probe and return typed NodeProbe data.

definitions.name: read-text!
definitions.doc: Synchronous node:fs.readFileSync adapter. Text uses UTF-8; filesystem failures raise the original host exception. No recursive deletion.

definitions.name: real-path!
definitions.doc: Synchronous node:fs.realpathSync adapter. Text uses UTF-8; filesystem failures raise the original host exception. No recursive deletion.

definitions.name: rename!
definitions.doc: Synchronous node:fs.renameSync adapter. Text uses UTF-8; filesystem failures raise the original host exception. No recursive deletion.

definitions.name: rmdir!
definitions.doc: Synchronous node:fs.rmdirSync adapter. Text uses UTF-8; filesystem failures raise the original host exception. No recursive deletion.

definitions.name: runtime
definitions.doc: Return the normalized Runtime node enum variant.

definitions.name: runtime-name
definitions.doc: Return the literal runtime identifier |node. Example: (runtime-name) => |node

definitions.name: unlink!
definitions.doc: Synchronous node:fs.unlinkSync adapter. Text uses UTF-8; filesystem failures raise the original host exception. No recursive deletion.

definitions.name: uptime
definitions.doc: Read and validate Node process metadata.

definitions.name: write-text!
definitions.doc: Synchronous node:fs.writeFileSync adapter. Text uses UTF-8; filesystem failures raise the original host exception. No recursive deletion.

definitions.name: AbortControllerHost
definitions.doc: External AbortController capability with a typed signal and parameterless abort wrapper contract.

definitions.name: AbortSignalHost
definitions.doc: External AbortSignal capability. Reason stays an opaque nullable host object because JavaScript permits arbitrary values.

definitions.name: ConsoleHost
definitions.doc: External console capability shared by browser and Node. Methods intentionally accept one String to avoid modeling host varargs.

definitions.name: DateHost
definitions.doc: External JavaScript Date capability exposing only stable read methods needed for normalization.

definitions.name: DateSnapshot
definitions.doc: Immutable normalized view of a host Date with epoch milliseconds and ISO text.

definitions.name: HeadersHost
definitions.doc: External Headers capability with typed String keys and values; iteration is deliberately normalized elsewhere.

definitions.name: HttpMethod
definitions.doc: Closed HTTP method set used by typed request options; custom methods remain an explicit adapter concern.

definitions.name: JsError
definitions.doc: Normalized JavaScript exception data. Stack is optional because hosts may omit it.

definitions.name: JsErrorKind
definitions.doc: Stable error categories shared by browser and Node adapters; unknown host names retain their String payload.

definitions.name: RequestOptions
definitions.doc: Calcit-owned request configuration converted to a JavaScript object only inside an adapter.

definitions.name: ResponseHost
definitions.doc: External Response metadata capability. Async body readers are omitted until adapters normalize their Promise results.

definitions.name: ResponseSnapshot
definitions.doc: Normalized response metadata after a host Response has been inspected and its headers copied.

definitions.name: Runtime
definitions.doc: Runtime identity normalized as a Calcit enum instead of an open String.

definitions.name: UrlHost
definitions.doc: External URL-like capability shared by URL and browser Location objects. Fields are read-only in this contract.

definitions.name: UrlSearchParamsHost
definitions.doc: External URLSearchParams capability. Nullable lookup remains JsNullish<String> until an adapter converts it to Option.

definitions.name: UrlSnapshot
definitions.doc: Immutable URL fields copied out of a host URL or Location object.

definitions.name: abort!
definitions.doc: Abort the controller. Repeated aborts are safe.

definitions.name: abort-controller-create
definitions.doc: Construct a native AbortController and retain its typed host identity. Invalid constructor inputs raise host exceptions.

definitions.name: abort-signal
definitions.doc: Return the controller signal, preserving identity.

definitions.name: aborted?
definitions.doc: Read whether a signal has been aborted.

definitions.name: console-error!
definitions.doc: Write one error String to the host console and return Unit in browser or Node.

definitions.name: console-log!
definitions.doc: Write one String to the host console and normalize the host undefined return to Unit.

definitions.name: console-warn!
definitions.doc: Write one warning String to the host console and return Unit in browser or Node.

definitions.name: date-now-snapshot
definitions.doc: Create a host Date and immediately normalize it to DateSnapshot in browser or Node.

definitions.name: date-snapshot
definitions.doc: Copy a typed host Date into Calcit-owned DateSnapshot data.

definitions.name: decode-uri-component
definitions.doc: Read the native result through a checked primitive boundary. Invalid input may raise a host exception.

definitions.name: encode-uri-component
definitions.doc: Read the native result through a checked primitive boundary. Invalid input may raise a host exception.

definitions.name: headers-append!
definitions.doc: Append a header value using native Headers normalization.

definitions.name: headers-create
definitions.doc: Construct a native Headers and retain its typed host identity. Invalid constructor inputs raise host exceptions.

definitions.name: headers-delete!
definitions.doc: Remove a key and return Unit.

definitions.name: headers-get
definitions.doc: Lookup a key; missing values become Option.none.

definitions.name: headers-has?
definitions.doc: Check whether a key exists.

definitions.name: headers-set!
definitions.doc: Replace the values for a key.

definitions.name: http-method-label
definitions.doc: Convert HttpMethod to the uppercase token expected by JavaScript request APIs.

definitions.name: now-ms
definitions.doc: Read the native result through a checked primitive boundary. Invalid input may raise a host exception.

definitions.name: performance-now
definitions.doc: Read the native result through a checked primitive boundary. Invalid input may raise a host exception.

definitions.name: queue-microtask!
definitions.doc: Queue a Unit callback in the JavaScript microtask queue.

definitions.name: runtime-label
definitions.doc: Convert Runtime to the stable host label used in logs and compatibility checks.

definitions.name: search-params-create
definitions.doc: Construct a native URLSearchParams and retain its typed host identity. Invalid constructor inputs raise host exceptions.

definitions.name: search-params-delete!
definitions.doc: Remove a key and return Unit.

definitions.name: search-params-get
definitions.doc: Lookup a key; missing values become Option.none.

definitions.name: search-params-has?
definitions.doc: Check whether a key exists.

definitions.name: search-params-set!
definitions.doc: Replace the values for a key.

definitions.name: search-params-size
definitions.doc: Count query entries, including duplicate keys.

definitions.name: search-params-string
definitions.doc: Serialize query parameters with standard percent encoding.

definitions.name: url-create
definitions.doc: Construct a native URL and retain its typed host identity. Invalid constructor inputs raise host exceptions.

definitions.name: url-snapshot
definitions.doc: Copy a URL-like host object into immutable UrlSnapshot data without retaining host identity.
